findings.note: C1: the case says to make the unsaved edit on the pipeline Description. The AFS directs the implementer to edit the LLM node's System field instead (pipeline-llm-node-system-value). The AFS records the full reasoning under Clarifications; I did not re-check it.

C2: Run History is a route (/pipelines/all/<id>/history), not an inline panel. After navigating back, the panel is closed and the conversation is gone. The implementer must not carry the conversation across the Run History round-trip, so the Run History check should come last in the session or the test should re-send.

On DEV, platform banners (platform-banner-center, then platform-banner-corner) intercept clicks about 6 s after load. The test must dismiss them. The context pill shows only once a conversation exists, and its percentage varies, so assert the regex ^\d+%$.
